name: Scale AI
desc: Human data and evaluations for frontier labs
desc_zh: 为前沿实验室提供人工数据与评测
solves: Post-training needs rated human answers at volume, and a lab has neither the people nor the process. Scale supplies both, and keeps humans in the loop.
solves_zh: 后训练需要成规模、有人评分过的答案，实验室既缺人也缺流程。Scale 两样都提供，并让人留在环里。
best_for: Training or evaluating a model where human judgement is the real bottleneck.
best_for_zh: 训练或评测模型，而人工判断是真正卡住的那一环。
notes: Made post-training data a purchasable commodity rather than an internal chore. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://handwiki.org/wiki/Company:Scale_AI
